description: Search the register for every launch that carried a ticker symbol or a launch name. Launch identity is free to copy, so one name is often many mints from many wallets; this returns the count, the wallets behind it and the recent launches, as dated observations. Useful for questions like whether a token by some name has launched before, or how many times a ticker has been reused.

kind.description: Search by ticker symbol or by launch name

value.description: The ticker (e.g. PNUT) or the exact launch name

name: search_ticker_or_name
title: Search a ticker or name
